description: Start an empty score: music made in layers and rendered to audio media for a timeline. A score is its own document beside the timeline: parts (layers), each with devices (instruments, then effects) and regions (stretches of notes or audio) on a grid of beats. tempo, meter and sample_rate are required; nothing is assumed. Positions are beats from 0 (a quarter note is 1; decimals allowed); results give each one in seconds too, and in frames when fps is given, and any position argument can be given in seconds instead (at_seconds for at_beats, and so on). Scores are immutable: every edit returns a new score_id, and older ids stay valid for 7 days after last use. For work longer than that, keep the score.get document on your side and restore it with score.load. Returns the score_id.

fps.description: {num, den}: a timeline's frame rate. With it, every position also comes back in frames

meter.description: {beats, unit}: beats in a bar and the note that is one beat, e.g. {beats: 4, unit: 4}

unit.description: The note that is one beat: 4 a quarter, 8 an eighth

sample_rate.description: 44100 or 48000: of the audio it renders

tempo.description: Beats per minute, 20 to 400, decimals allowed

name: score.create

score_id.description: Score handle; every edit returns a new one

title: Create score
